name: PTS Private Parties — Daily background refresh and current pipeline

parameters.query: select t.account_id,t.studio_id,coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('source_lead_id',l.source_lead_id,'received_date',l.received_date,'received_date_basis',l.received_date_basis) order by l.source_lead_id) from public.pts_private_party_leads l where l.studio_id=t.studio_id),'[]'::jsonb) as known_leads from public.pts_collection_targets t order by t.account_id,t.studio_id;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { requestId: "party-"+$execution.id+"-"+$json.studio_id, accountId: Number($json.account_id), studioId: Number($json.studio_id), knownLeads: $json.known_leads } }}

parameters.jsCode: const jobs=$input.all().map(i=>i.json);const targets=$('Configured studios and known identities').all().map(i=>i.json);if(jobs.length!==targets.length||new Set(jobs.map(j=>j.jobId)).size!==jobs.length||jobs.some(j=>!targets.some(t=>Number(t.studio_id)===j.studioId&&Number(t.account_id)===j.accountId)))throw Error('Source job identity mismatch');if(jobs.some(j=>j.status==='failed'))throw Error('Source collection failed before warehouse update');return [{json:{ready:jobs.every(j=>j.status==='completed'),jobs}}];

parameters.query: insert into public.pts_private_party_import_runs(studio_id,account_id,source_count,source_first_date,source_last_date,history_from) select $1::bigint,$2::bigint,$3::integer,$4::date,$5::date,$6::date where exists(select 1 from public.pts_collection_targets where studio_id=$1::bigint and account_id=$2::bigint) returning id,studio_id,account_id;

parameters.jsCode: const sources=$('Validate minimized history').all().map(i=>i.json);const runs=$input.all().map(i=>i.json);if(runs.length!==sources.length)throw Error('Missing studio run');const seen=new Set();return runs.flatMap(run=>{const source=sources.find(s=>s.studioId===Number(run.studio_id)&&s.accountId===Number(run.account_id));if(!source||!run.id||seen.has(run.studio_id))throw Error('Account/studio run mismatch');seen.add(run.studio_id);const out=[];for(let i=0;i<source.rows.length;i+=500)out.push({json:{runId:run.id,rows:source.rows.slice(i,i+500)}});return out.length?out:[{json:{runId:run.id,rows:[]}}];});

const runs=$('Open studio import run').all().map(i=>i.json);const sources=$('Validate minimized history').all().map(i=>i.json);const written=$input.all().map(i=>i.json);if(written.some(w=>!runs.some(r=>r.id===w.run_id)))throw Error('Unknown acknowledgement');return runs.map(run=>{const source=sources.find(s=>s.studioId===Number(run.studio_id)&&s.accountId===Number(run.account_id));const count=written.filter(w=>w.run_id===run.id).reduce((n,w)=>n+Number(w.written),0);if(!source||count!==source.sourceCount)throw Error('Studio count mismatch');return {json:{runId:run.id}};});

parameters.query: update public.pts_private_party_import_runs set status='completed',completed_at=now() where id=$1::uuid and status='loading' and loaded_count=source_count returning id,studio_id,source_count,loaded_count,completed_at,history_from,unknown_date_count;
